brief: A confident 30 second promo of an artist reviewing framed astronaut art prints in a studio
crewStatus: The edit suite hums to life as scopes calibrate against deep space blacks and studio amber, dialing in the rhythm for a sharp thirty-second showcase of the artist admiring framed lunar prints.
directorLog: [DIRECTOR] This cut is about uncompromised creative vision and the fierce pride of an artist looking at their own finished cosmos. The final shot must leave the viewer with a sharp, unbroken gaze from the artist that demands attention.

look_for: hands touching the frames close up
eyes scanning across the astronaut artwork
sharp shifts in lighting across the studio
deliberate nodding or decisive head movements
reflections of the art in the artist glasses or eyes
avoid: static tripod wides longer than 3 seconds
slow panning without a clear focal point
dead air where no movement happens on screen
